topic: How would the 0.25 dB passband loss affect link budget margins in low-noise satellite receiver frontends?
consensus_response: The 0.25 dB passband loss reduces link budget margins by decreasing signal-to-noise ratio, compromising system reliability and capacity. Mitigations include optimizing power allocation, adjusting modulation schemes, and maximizing antenna gains to maintain optimal performance.
reference_context: SatCom systems rely on link budget equations, considering parameters like antenna gain, noise temperature, and losses to ensure reliable transmission.
